Internal Control Officer Job at AfyA Care




        
    

        
        AfyA Care is a healthcare-specific investment and operational company with a vision to make healthcare accessible and affordable to Nigerians and Africans. We are building vertically integrated healthcare institutions that serve large urban market segments through the creation and aggregation of hospital capacity and demand for healthcare. We are a fast-growing organization and our portfolio is being built by a mix of brownfield and greenfield strategies. We currently have within our portfolio as operating companies (OpCos), Hospitals, a Health Insurer, a Diagnostics company and a HealthTech company.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Internal Control Officer 

Job Location: Lagos
     

            
    



Responsibilities


	The role focuses on identifying operational and financial leakages. assessing compliance With established policies and præesses, reviewing the integrity of financial and Operational data, and ensuring effective controls across business operations.
	The incumbent will supp•rt risk management. conduct control track identified exceptions, and provide clear findings and recommendations to strengthen operational efficiency. compliance, and accountability across the Group.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in accounting, Finance, Economics, Insurance, Information Technology, or a related field.
	3 - 5 years of progressive experience in internal control Or internal audit - preferably within healthcare,
	Professional Certification: Professional certification such as ACA ACCA, CISA, CIA, or CFE is strongy preferred.
	HMQ pharmaceuticals, financial services, or health tech sectors.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

CAD Design Engineer Job at Uniccon Group




        
    

        
        Uniccon Group is the home of innovative and customizable tech products to meet your needs. We combine world-class expertise, experience, and modern tools to scale up your productivity. Valuing and collaborating for the best services have kept us ahead of the market. Individuals, SMEs, organisation, and government agencies achieve more with us.
     

            
    



Uniccon Group owns Africa’s leading hub for STEM research, training, and solutions (STEMFocus). Research is the bedrock of our innovative services in the marketplace, payment gateway, workflow optimization, financial intel, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and e-learning products. We are futuristic and leading with METAVERSE and NFTs in Africa. The operations extend to Agro-commodities processing and export, fashion brands, and general contracting business. It oversees operations across Africa, Asia, Europe, the Americas, and other parts of the world. The products are innovative, and customizable to meet market needs. Unicorn Group is a key player in their respective industries.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: CAD Design Engineer 

Job Location: Abuja
Job type: Full time

Core Purpose


	To create detailed 3D models, mechanical assemblies, and production drawings for UAV/drone airframes and structural components optimized for manufacturing and physical assembly.


Key Responsibilities & Technical Expectations


	3D Modeling & Drafting: Design detailed 3D parts, complex hierarchical assemblies, and standard 2D engineering drawings using industry-standard CAD platforms.
	Structural & Mechanical Layout: Design UAV airframe components, selecting appropriate materials, fasteners, structural layouts, and manufacturing tolerances.
	Prototyping & Manufacturing Support: Apply Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles across 3D printing, CNC machining, and composite fabrication workflows.


Candidate Requirements


	Education: Candidates should possess an ND/HND in Mechanical, Aerospace/Aeronautical, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline. Fresh graduates with strong CAD portfolios are encouraged to apply.
	Technical Software Suite: Proficiency in standard CAD software (SolidWorks, CATIA, Siemens NX, Fusion 360, or equivalent).
	Practical Skills: Hands-on experience with UAVs, RC aircraft, robotics, or rapid mechanical prototyping; solid understanding of DFM/DFA and fabrication techniques.
	Core Competencies: High attention to geometric detail, strong problem-solving mindset, effective technical communication, and team collaboration.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV, Portfolio, or a summary of your experience to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

	Monitor adherence to policies, procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
	Conduct investigations into policy breaches, fraud, or misconduct.
	Prepare and present exception reports to management.
	Evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls and recommend enhancements.

	Review business processes to identify control weaknesses and operational inefficiencies.
	Advise on process improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
	Ensure processes are accurately documented and followed.
	Foster a culture of continuous improvement across the organization.

	Conduct compliance audits to ensure regulatory adherence.
	Prepare compliance reports and exception summaries.
	Stay updated on changes in laws, regulations, and industry standards.
	Ensure the organization remains compliant with all applicable requirements.

	Lead complex investigations into suspected policy breaches, fraud, or misconduct.
	Document findings thoroughly and recommend corrective actions.
	Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to implement remediation measures.

	Review credit assessments to ensure lending decisions are sound and aligned with policy.

 Job Position: Operational Excellence Engineer

Job Location: Kano
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Description


	The Operational Excellence Engineer is responsible for the end-to-end management of spare parts, including specification, procurement coordination, inventory control, storage optimization, and utilization monitoring.
	The role ensures critical spare parts availability while optimizing inventory levels and costs.
	In addition, the engineer will lead and support continuous improvement initiatives and engineering projects aimed at improving equipment reliability, maintenance efficiency, and operational performance.
	The position also requires developing strong relationships with equipment suppliers, identifying new suppliers, and implementing improved systems and processes for spare parts and maintenance management.


Responsibilities and Tasks
Spare Parts Management:


	Manage the full lifecycle of spare parts from identification and specification through procurement, storage, and utilization.
	Define and maintain critical spare parts lists for production and facility equipment.
	Work closely with maintenance teams to ensure availability of essential spare parts and prevent equipment downtime.
	Monitor spare parts consumption and maintain optimal inventory levels.
	Develop and maintain spare parts catalogues, technical specifications, and documentation.
	Coordinate with procurement to ensure timely purchasing and delivery of spare parts.
	Optimize storage systems and inventory organization in the spare parts warehouse.
	Implement and maintain spare parts tracking systems (ERP/CMMS).
	Conduct periodic inventory audits and reconciliation.


Supplier Management & Technical Sourcing:


	Develop and maintain relationships with equipment manufacturers and spare parts suppliers.
	Identify and evaluate new suppliers to improve quality, availability, and cost competitiveness.
	Request quotations and evaluate technical compliance of spare parts.
	Support procurement during technical negotiations with suppliers.
	Coordinate with suppliers for technical support, troubleshooting, and equipment improvements


Continuous Improvement:


	Identify opportunities to improve maintenance processes, spare parts management, and equipment reliability.
	Implement process improvements using engineering and reliability principles.
	Develop better systems for spare parts tracking, planning, and forecasting.
	Analyze equipment failures and propose engineering solutions to reduce recurrence.
	Support implementation of predictive and preventive maintenance strategies.


Engineering Projects:


	Participate in engineering projects related to equipment upgrades, modifications, or installations.
	Support equipment improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and reliability.
	Coordinate with suppliers and contractors during project execution.
	Prepare technical documentation, reports, and project updates.


Requirements


	Education degree – Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
	Work experience – 3–7 years of experience in Maintenance Engineering, Spare Parts Management, or Reliability Engineering in an industrial environment. Experience working with spare parts and maintenance management system in addition to AutoCAD and strong technical understanding of industrial equipment and spare parts.
	Language skills – English.
	Computer skills – MS Word, MS Excel & Outlook.


Other required skills:


	Spare parts lifecycle management.
	Supplier relationship management.
	Inventory and warehouse optimization.
	Engineering problem solving and root cause analysis.
	Continuous improvement methodologies.
	Project coordination and technical documentation.
	Strong analytical and organizational skills.
	Effective communication and supplier negotiation skills.
